recordedFrom.statement: all accepted move to the next phase

decisions.selectedValue: Use Substantial Variability, Occasional Variability, and Undetermined / Needs Review with neutral reviewer context.
decisions.rationale: A fixed three-label vocabulary supports blind classification and preserves an explicit uncertainty outcome.

decisions.selectedValue: Collect independent human-review need, rationale, and Low/Medium/High review priority for every row.
decisions.rationale: The same blind review can create a separate target for routing evaluation without using Agent 4 output as ground truth.

decisions.selectedValue: Both independent reviewers label all 24 evaluation rows.
decisions.rationale: Complete paired coverage enables reviewer agreement and paired baseline/candidate evaluation.

decisions.selectedValue: Use two independent human reviewers with domain-modeling assessment experience who did not create the VEGO-AI predictions under review.
decisions.rationale: Relevant expertise and separation from the evaluated predictions reduce construct and confirmation bias.

decisions.selectedValue: Provide written participant information and obtain affirmative consent before calibration; comply with any applicable institutional ethics requirement and infer no waiver.
decisions.rationale: Human-study participation and data use require explicit information and consent even when records are pseudonymous.

decisions.selectedValue: Use pseudonymous reviewer IDs; store returns only under the ignored local evidence root; transfer one-to-one through institutional email or an access-controlled drive; retain through thesis acceptance plus 12 months, then delete subject to institutional policy.
decisions.rationale: This minimizes personal data exposure while preserving a bounded audit window.

decisions.selectedValue: Use a supervisor-authorized human adjudicator who is not acting as either primary reviewer; preserve both raw returns unchanged.
decisions.rationale: Adjudication must be a separate human decision layer and cannot rewrite the original evidence.

decisions.selectedValue: Use the hidden 16-development/8-sealed split and open the sealed partition once after a candidate policy is frozen.
decisions.rationale: A sealed pilot limits direct policy tuning on the evaluation subset.

decisions.selectedValue: Use macro-F1 as the primary classification metric and net correction as the primary paired metric.
decisions.rationale: Macro-F1 protects minority-class visibility and net correction makes gains and regressions explicit.

decisions.selectedValue: Report the paper comparison as Not directly comparable unless the same independent cohort, labels, baseline, and metric protocol can be reconstructed.
decisions.rationale: Historical mechanism counts cannot support a classification-superiority claim without an equivalent reference protocol.

operationalPolicy.reviewerEligibility: Two independent humans with domain-modeling assessment experience who did not create the evaluated VEGO-AI predictions
operationalPolicy.consentAndEthics: Written participant information and affirmative consent before calibration; comply with applicable institutional requirements and infer no ethics waiver
operationalPolicy.reviewerIds: Pseudonymous stable IDs reviewer_1 and reviewer_2
operationalPolicy.transferChannel: Private one-to-one institutional email or access-controlled drive
operationalPolicy.retentionPeriod: Through thesis acceptance plus 12 months, then delete subject to institutional policy
operationalPolicy.adjudicatorRole: Supervisor-authorized human who is not either primary reviewer
operationalPolicy.reviewerIndependence: Reviewers work independently and cannot consult VEGO-AI, memory output, generative AI, or one another
operationalPolicy.evaluationReleaseRule: Release evaluation files only after two valid calibration returns and a human-frozen instruction manifest

claimBoundary: Approval advances the study to calibration only. It creates no expert label, accuracy result, generalization result, effort result, paper-superiority result, topology selection, or routing-policy superiority.
